system_overview: This module provides a library of fundamental mathematical definitions about functions, including restriction, range (image), inverse, injection, surjection, and bijection. Originally contributed by Tom Rodeheffer at Microsoft Research, it is part of the standard proof library used by the TLA Proof System. It serves as a utility module imported by other specifications that need to reason about function properties.
actors_and_components: There are no actors or concurrent components. This is a purely definitional module that introduces operators for reasoning about mathematical functions between sets.
additional_assumptions: This is a helper module from the standard proof library. It defines no behavior or temporal properties. It is included to support proof modules that rely on function-theoretic reasoning.
